Stage 1 · 1K users
ECS Fargate: 2 api · 2 realtime ·
1 astro · 2 workers
Mongo M30 replica set
₹1.5–2.5L/mo

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Stage 2 · 100K users
autoscaled 6–10 api · 8 realtime
Mongo M50 + us-east-1 read replica
Redis cluster · 600 voice streams
warm standby region
₹8–14L/mo

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Stage 3 · 1M users
EKS · 30–60 api pods · 40+ realtime
Mongo M80+ sharded ×3
(messages · memories · briefings)
Online Archive · 6K voice streams
₹45–70L/mo

multi-region active-active (stateless)
Global Cluster zone-sharded
by residency · 40K+ voice streams
12M notifications/hr
₹2.5–4Cr/mo
